audit_metadata.mission: Critical Notification System Repair and Full Mobile UI Regression Audit

defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.name: Horizontal RenderFlex Overflow on Notification Card (Right Overflowed by 3.2px)
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.symptom: Flutter layout warning: 'A RenderFlex overflowed by 3.2 pixels on the right' rendered across the top right of pinned notification cards.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.root_cause: The notification card header row contained Channel badge (e.g. 'ANNOUNCEMENT'), PINNED badge, and HIGH priority badge alongside a Spacer, timestamp, unread pulse dot, and PopupMenuButton in a single rigid unconstrained Row. On a 360dp phone viewport with card margins and padding (usable inner width 296dp), the row elements summed to 299.2dp, causing an exact 3.2px overflow.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.solution: Refactored the header row using Expanded(child: Wrap(spacing: 5, runSpacing: 4, children: [badges...])) on the left and a dedicated Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min) for timestamp and action menu on the right. Badges wrap gracefully onto a second line on narrow viewports without pushing trailing metadata offscreen.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.verification: VERIFIED in unit/widget test 'Pinned notification with HIGH priority and ANNOUNCEMENT does not overflow at 360dp' and clean flutter analyze.

defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.name: Pinned Notifications Permitted to be Deleted via Swipe-Left and Popup Menu
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.symptom: Pinned notifications could still be swiped left to delete or deleted via individual delete action, violating the pin-protection specification.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.root_cause:
1. Dismissible confirmDismiss for swipe-left (endToStart) did not verify item.isPinned before unregistering the item and executing deletion.
2. PopupMenuButton delete handler did not verify item.isPinned.
3. Backend soft_delete_notification and DELETE /api/v1/notifications/{log_id} lacked a check for log.is_pinned == True.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.solution:
1. In confirmDismiss: if item.isPinned, dismiss is rejected (returns false) and a floating SnackBar 'Pinned notifications cannot be deleted. Unpin first.' is shown.
2. In PopupMenuButton: delete option is disabled with 'Protected (Pinned)' label and lock icon when pinned; tapping delete directly blocks deletion.
3. In NotificationService: deleteNotification and removeNotificationLocally check item.isPinned and refuse removal.
4. In Backend: soft_delete_notification returns False if log.is_pinned, and DELETE /api/v1/notifications/{log_id} raises HTTP 400 Bad Request if pinned.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.verification: VERIFIED via pytest test_pinned_notification_cannot_be_deleted_until_unpinned (HTTP 400 assertion) and flutter widget test.

defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.name: Deleted Notifications Reappearing on Refresh / Pagination
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.symptom: Deleted notifications reappeared when navigating away and back or executing pull-to-refresh.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.root_cause: Historical deletion was previously client-memory only without database persistence or query exclusion.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.solution: Soft-delete persisted via is_deleted (Boolean, indexed) and deleted_at (DateTime) columns in NotificationLog. All inbox history queries, unread count queries, and pagination routes strictly filter NotificationLog.is_deleted == False.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.verification: VERIFIED via test_soft_delete_persistence_and_inbox_exclusion (database persistence and refresh exclusion).

defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.name: Dismissible Widget Tree Crash on Gesture Interaction
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.symptom: Red error screen: 'A dismissed Dismissible widget is still part of the tree.'
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.root_cause: Framework invariant violation: Dismissible requires either synchronous removal from the tree when returning true, or returning false when widget remains in the tree.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.solution: confirmDismiss returns false for swipe-right (pin/unpin) so widget snaps back cleanly to its slot while updating state post-frame; returns true for swipe-left (delete) on unpinned items while synchronously calling removeNotificationLocally.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.verification: VERIFIED in test/notification_delete_pin_test.dart across 7 automated test cases.

defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.name: Deterministic Pin Ordering and Bulk Deletion Safety
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.symptom: Pinned notifications did not consistently stay at the top across refreshes, and bulk deletion risked deleting pinned records.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.root_cause: Missing composite sorting logic and lack of unpinned-only filtering in bulk delete endpoint.
defects_diagnosed_and_resolved.solution: Configured deterministic sorting: is_pinned.desc(), pinned_at.desc(), created_at.desc() in both backend SQL queries and Flutter NotificationService._sortNotifications(). Bulk-delete endpoint deletes strictly is_pinned == False and returns truthful deleted and pinned_preserved counts.

key_tests: removeNotificationLocally strictly ignores pinned notifications: PASS
Pinned notification with HIGH priority and ANNOUNCEMENT does not overflow at 360dp: PASS
Swipe left on pinned notification does not dismiss it and keeps card in tree: PASS
NotificationService sorts pinned notifications deterministically to top: PASS
